text: I need this car pic made into three sizes, because I’m trying to get the same photo ready to use in a few places. I always worry about a car looking awkward when the picture gets resized. The versions I need are square, 4:5 for the feed, and 9:16 for stories, and I need them sent as three separate pictures. Please keep the whole car in each one rather than cutting any of it off. Blurred photo padding is fine if a crop won’t work. No text, please.
